notes.title: ANIME MATCH Update Released
notes.notes:
An update to ANIME MATCH has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart ANIME MATCH. The major changes include:

[list]
[*] Removed nearly identical white bathing suit with blue polka-dot card.
[/list]

If you wish to play the previous version of ANIME MATCH, switch to the "legacy" beta branch by doing the following:

[olist]
[*] Right-click ANIME MATCH in your Steam library.
[*] Click Properties...
[*] On the left side of the window that appears, click "Betas."
[*] Select "legacy - ANIME MATCH 1.0" from the "Select the beta you want to opt in to" dropdown.
[/olist]
